visual_review.scope: Keyframes 0/6/12/18/24 and edge crops, not manual visual inspection of every frame

input_figures_reviewed.am_00: Complete single foreground; controlled translation/rotation; no interior source-frame cuts in keyframes
input_figures_reviewed.am_05: Two depth layers overlap; second foreground uses estimated source color; no new crop boundary
input_figures_reviewed.am_06: Complete woolly foreground; low contrast against bright background
input_figures_reviewed.am_11: Second opaque foreground behind woolly foreground; overlap present
input_figures_reviewed.vm_00: Jumping subject partially exits upper frame; cut stays at image edge; weak blur
input_figures_reviewed.vm_01: Turning garment and hair; complete foreground inside canvas
input_figures_reviewed.vm_02: Fast hair and arm motion; fine alpha silhouette
input_figures_reviewed.vm_03: Arm movement; source framing ends at output boundary; background focus
input_figures_reviewed.vm_04: Garment/hand motion against bright night trails; weak blur
input_figures_reviewed.vm_05: Pose and hand motion; lower-body source cut remains on output edge
input_figures_reviewed.vm_06: Close-up moving fine hair; cropped portrait remains at frame edge
input_figures_reviewed.vm_07: Limb movement against high-contrast sunset; background focus
input_figures_reviewed.vm_08: Jumping limbs with weak blur; no source-frame rectangle
input_figures_reviewed.vm_09: Ball and person separated in alpha, assigned same planar foreground depth
input_figures_reviewed.vm_10: Hair changes silhouette rapidly; soft alpha retained
input_figures_reviewed.vm_11: Multiple people share one source plane; real inter-person appearance change is not separate 3D geometry

visual_review.AM_other_variants: RGB/Alpha/Mask equality checked on all frames against am_00 or am_06; parameter/depth checks separately applied to every scene
visual_review.reference_finding: No obvious newly introduced construction/halo/occlusion-order failure in the five reviewed keyframes per scene. This is not exhaustive manual visual review of all 600 frames.
visual_review.prediction_review: All 600 outputs structurally checked and scored; targeted visual checks on vm_11 highest-FD transitions, not a claim of visually approving every predicted frame.

FD_outlier.finding: No obvious temporal index mismatch or isolated corrupt output in inspected high-FD transitions; cannot uniquely attribute flow differences to model motion error versus RAFT sensitivity under blur/occlusion

metrics.scope: 24 development scenes; Any-to-Bokeh prediction/reference distance, not renderer accuracy or official benchmark scores

metrics.SSIM: Gaussian sigma1.5, RGB, skimage population covariance
metrics.FD: torchvision RAFT-large C_T_SKHT_V2, full resolution, mean L1 flow difference over 24 transitions
metrics.RM: mean absolute difference of predicted and reference frame differences over all 24 transitions
metrics.FVD: not reported: distribution-estimator stability not established for this development set

notes: Scene averages are descriptive; paired AM variants share sources and are not independent samples
Weak physical radii stay separate from >=2px calibration claims
FVD not reported; estimator stability not established

FD_outlier_diagnostic.finding: No obvious temporal index mismatch or isolated corrupt output in inspected high-FD transitions; cannot uniquely attribute flow differences to model motion error versus RAFT sensitivity under blur/occlusion
FD_outlier_diagnostic.acceptance_note: Diagnostic observation only; no new pass/fail threshold and not a reason to exclude the scene

execution.overlap: Cycles OptiX and Any-to-Bokeh run concurrently; 96GB card, prior combined demand below capacity
execution.timing_scope: Pilot only; concurrent per-process times are not standardized efficiency scores
execution.metric_overlap: Per-scene metric batches may overlap remaining Cycles renders; no Table 3 timing claims

timing_note: Some processes overlapped; per-process timing is not wall-clock duration or standardized Table 3 efficiency. Reused timings come from prior v2 run.
limitations: Dynamic layered planes; no claim of real 3D human geometry or physically reconstructed illumination
Visual reference review used 5 keyframes per scene, not exhaustive manual review of every frame; numerical structure checks cover all 600 frames
AM paired variants share foreground/background sources; group averages are descriptive, not independent-sample significance tests
vm_00/vm_04/vm_08 have 1.3333px nonzero nominal radius and remain resolution-limited for the current radius estimator
High FD in vm_11 retained; motion-error versus flow-estimator sensitivity is not uniquely identified
FVD not calculated; official test dataset and formal benchmark are distinct from this development set
